summary: The audit checks the 12 letter-graded units of core courses, 21 units of CS, statistics, math and engineering including CS 161, STATS 200 and STATS 315A or CS 229 (at most 9 units numbered 100-199, and at most 8 units taken S/NC), 4 units of social and ethical issues including MED 255, 6 units of domain biology or medicine, and 135 graduate units. The 3.0 GPA, two research rotations in the first year, regular seminar and colloquium attendance, the thesis pre-proposal seminar, two TA assignments, the qualifying exam by the end of the second year, candidacy, the oral exam, a publishable paper and the dissertation are checked by hand.

program.why: Policies: "The PhD program requires 135 units; 43 of those units should be formal coursework (classroom-based courses, not research units)." The Bulletin's program minimum (43) is the formal coursework, which the course rules already add up to.

totals.label: Satisfactory/No Credit CS, statistics, math and engineering units
totals.why: "Up to eight units of this portion of the core curriculum may be taken on a Satisfactory/No Credit basis". The codes are the CS/Stats/Math/Eng electives list, leaving out the courses also on the Domain Biology or Medicine list ("Domain Biology courses can be taken as Credit/No Credit") and HRP 263, also a Social and Ethical Issues course, with their cross-listings ("These courses may be taken on a Satisfactory/No credit basis").

aNZIrqA7.why: "Core Biomedical Data Science Courses (12 units)" (BMDS 214 is offered for 1-4 units) and "These courses should be taken for a grade, when letter grades are offered."

12k3tYM2.why: "In addition to the 10-13 units students will earn through the Required Courses listed above, students should also choose courses from the electives list below to reach the total of 21 units needed for this requirement." The required courses are part of the 21 units (all are on the electives list), so this rule names them inside that total.

sxyT4XYr.why: The section's text only says "After applying for Terminal Graduate Registration (TGR) status and completing 135 units, the PhD candidate should register each quarter for BIOMEDIN 802 TGR PhD Dissertation", which is registration, not a course requirement. Candidacy is in the Policies: "Doctoral students generally advance to PhD candidacy after passing the qualifying exam, which takes place by the end of the second year of training ... The student must fulfill these requirements and apply for admission to candidacy for the PhD by the beginning of the third year."
